# velin-fade

Fade-in on scroll.

## Values
| Value | Meaning | Bridges to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (empty / present) | Fade in on scroll | Motion runtime |
## Example

```html
<div velin-fade>…</div>
```

## Accessibility

Honors `prefers-reduced-motion`.
